scope: independent root audit of the beta endpoint load-coordinate unit, exact-zero-stratum degree preservation, canonical-box and half-window ranks, fixed-n actual-orbit collapse, and capacity admission

mathematical_audit.endpoint_bridge: Independent continuant and prefix recurrences for 5<=n<=18 verify a*hatDelta_0-b*S=(-1)^n; the identity gives gcd(hatDelta_0,b)=1 without factoring b.
mathematical_audit.load_chart: The triangular substitution x_j=w_j*d_(j-1)-d_j is integral and invertible. The endpoint coefficient of d1 is sigma*hatDelta_0, so modulo every p^r with p|b the endpoint equation eliminates d1 and leaves d2 and every retained row load free.
mathematical_audit.degree_transfer: After any fixed exact-zero stratification the endpoint quotient is a polynomial-function algebra in the retained loads. Item362's unique reduced row-only singleton complement therefore keeps degree N(p-1), or (N-1)(p-1) only in the ambient p|N case. In the actual tied family N<=n-4<p.
mathematical_audit.box_interpolation: Because p>A exceeds every digit bound, coordinatewise Lagrange interpolation on the canonical box is valid. Its total-degree ceiling is 6+sum_(i>=2)w_i=2m^2+4m, but its coefficients depend on p and its rank remains beta-scale.
mathematical_audit.window_rank: The intermediate interval contains exactly (a+1)/2-ceil(a/(2c)) canonical words; since a/c<A, its logarithm is asymptotic to log a and log b.
mathematical_audit.actual_orbit: For fixed n the centered remainder is a single integer and has at most one canonical Ostrowski word. Pointwise degree collapse on that empty-or-singleton orbit is exact but cannot yield a candidate-independent nonzero integer carrier.
mathematical_audit.admission: Any candidate-independent nonzero integer vanishing for all actual singleton primes is divisible by their squarefree product U_11. A useful result therefore still needs a new sub-beta-scale height or weighted zero-density theorem.
